openings.claim: Prepare and verify order-specific parts sets before insertion.
openings.discriminator: Matched layouts/workers improve selection or checking; insertion may remain unchanged.
openings.probe: Counterbalance sample runs; separately time preparation, selection, insertion, checks and packing; inspect count/color.
openings.uncertainty: Mixed-layout switching and complexity are confounded; preparation may consume saved time or bench capacity. Retry widths overlap, weakening width-only explanations.

openings.claim: Ordered-layout diagrams explicitly locate the short partition.
openings.discriminator: Fewer placement errors and more unaided arrangements than generic diagrams.
openings.probe: Compare diagrams across ten participants with complete kits, balanced layouts and prior exposure.
openings.uncertainty: Guidance may be insufficient; prior learning and small samples limit generalization. Preparation/printing feasibility is unknown.

openings.claim: A reusable carrier maps each partition outline to its destination, combining visible inventory checks with customer assembly guidance; independently verify its count, component requirements and color against the original slip before loading.
openings.discriminator: Matching exposes omissions; destinations aid placement; independent order verification catches internally consistent swapped maps that physical occupancy alone cannot.
openings.probe: Reuse up to 15 samples for worker challenges with omissions, substitutions, swapped layouts and wrong colors; time map preparation/loading/both checks/packing; compare customer arrangements.
openings.uncertainty: Similar shapes, wrong maps, loose contents, shared mistaken specifications or rushed checks defeat checks. Slip accuracy, detachable retention, damage, two-worker/one-bench feasibility and time savings remain unverified. Closure interlocking is speculative and cannot verify order identity.

lineage.reason: Retains carrier-to-destination coupling and speculative closure boundary.
Retains independent order verification and comparative challenges.

decision: All are unvalidated synthetic hypotheses. Preserve 30x20 cm footprint, stationery capacity, removable partitions, accepted counts/colors and fixed delivery date; cap initial spending at 500 and recurring addition at 0.40/order. Measure actual costs and total workshop time before adoption. Rearrangement frequency and separate task times are unknown. Ten participants provide directional evidence; the 60-order pilot must achieve at least 59 complete orders, median time <=8 minutes and at least 54 unaided arrangements.
